evidence_sentence: The function checks the length of the I/O operation against a maximum limit, verifies the accessibility of the user buffer, and populates the I/O vector structure with the buffer address and length, while also updating the number of segments.
rationale: Only the fixed implementation limits kiocb->ki_nbytes to MAX_RW_COUNT before validating the buffer and storing the length in the iovec. The vulnerable implementation performs no maximum-length check and uses kiocb->ki_nbytes directly. The remaining described operations—access validation, populating the vector, and setting the segment count—occur in both versions.
rewritten_docstring: The function verifies the accessibility of the user buffer and populates the I/O vector structure with the buffer address and operation length, while also updating the number of segments.
